name: Bathyal-Cirque
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by towering mountain ranges. Farther poleward, past massive canyon systems, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
